title: Execute the complete A5 projector caller with fixed physical tapes and paid routing
body:
PR5114 supplies an algebra-faithful A5 address carrier, but its array XOR programs leave physical movement and rank-one-projector adaptation unpaid. This package executes PR4089’s complete four-call `diag([xy],[yx],1)` endpoint on that carrier using three arbitrary dirty data streams, an encoded runtime record width and three reusable private tapes.

The physical generator gathers all256 rows by charged sequential scans. Paid full-stream binary mixing adapts every three-role rank-one idempotent, including non-coordinate projectors, and restores the basis afterward. The complete caller preserves the borrowed width, restores its third dirty stream, returns every head and clears all private bodies and markers. The written all-q source-machine bound is `2^25(q+1)` operations; retained backing is at most `K0+257q+bitlen(q)+4`, including erased storage and arbitrary external blank tails.

Validation:62 physical executions cover all28 projectors for both source generators, non-coordinate widths3/5 and complete caller widths1/3/5/9. Nine semantic/lifecycle controls discriminate orientation, missing mixing, cleanup, heads, width preservation, aliasing, width domain and repeated disposal. Python3.12 normal/-O registered checks, committed-byte/source-history checks, official15-file export and Git-free cold replay pass. Exported controls reject missing RESULT/SOURCES, Boolean receipt aliasing, retained-source drift and omitted output cleanup; every exported byte is restored unchanged.

This is a typed successful-call source-machine proof, not a materialized binary transition table, an admitted recursive BIT supplier or a profitable native tariff. The movement constant is deliberately large. Recursive consumer frames, hosting, stock, supplier comparison and outer multiplication remain open; no kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. No heavy historical/selected/Lean replay was run. Independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is unclaimed.

Credit Nick Petalas PR5114 for the carrier and address action, Wentao Li PR4089 for the complete caller, and Cinna Davis PR2246/3914 with the retained register-model lineage. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
